title: Digital Vaccine Passport and Travel Bubble Arrangements
what_it_is: Digital Vaccine Passport and Travel Bubble Arrangements

sections.label: Mutual recognition of vaccination certificates
sections.summary: Singapore is exploring mutual recognition of vaccination certificates with several countries and regions, including Australia, requiring them to be secure, tamper-proof and verifiable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: But let me reiterate some of the points that Senior Minister of State Janil has made.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We are exploring with several countries and regions, including Australia, on the mutual recognition of vaccination certificates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The certificates can be physical or digital, and we will need them to be secure, tamper-proof and verifiable.

sections.label: Evaluating COVID-19 situation for air travel
sections.summary: Singapore will continue with MOH, MOT and other agencies to evaluate the COVID-19 situation in various countries and regions and explore restoring air travel when safe.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Singapore will continue – together with the Ministry of Health (MOH), MOT and other agencies – to holistically evaluate the COVID-19 situation in various countries and regions, and explore the possibility of restoring air travel when it is safe to do so.

sections.label: Travel bubble excludes transit passengers
sections.summary: Any travel bubble will not carry transit passengers, operating with only Origin Destination passengers, and Singapore continues to want to work with Hong Kong to restore this travel bubble.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Any travel bubble will not carry transit passengers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The travel bubble operates on the basis that the flights travelling within the bubble carries only what we call Origin Destination passengers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: So, transit passengers are outside of the bubble.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We continue to want to work with Hong Kong to restore this travel bubble.

sections.label: Singapore's MOH certification system
sections.summary: In Singapore, there is a very strong certification system run by MOH that is verifiable and notarised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: In Singapore, we have a very strong certification system run by MOH – verifiable, notarised.

sections.label: Borders opened to safe places
sections.summary: Singapore already opened its borders to safe places such as Brunei, New Zealand and Australia even before there were vaccines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: If a place is safe, such as Brunei, New Zealand, Australia, even before there were vaccines, we already opened our borders to them.
